prompt: Review an unseen messaging workload packet. Select queue, publish/subscribe or retained-log semantics; design identity, ordering, acknowledgements, consumers and effects; recover one duplicate/backlog/poison/rebalance/replica/replay incident; and revise the design after the reviewer changes one major correctness, scale, geography, privacy or cost constraint.

evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unfamiliar sanitized operations distributions topology settings histories and one changed constraint.
No production/shared broker real credential customer data host network/clock mutation or unbounded publish/replay.
Every fact and work item has an authority and each acknowledgement states who may forget what.
Stable identity survives producer retries consumer redelivery and replay.
Ordering scope follows an invariant; hottest partition and changed partition/key mapping are analyzed.
External effects are atomic idempotent or explicitly reconcilable; checkpoint timing is fault-tested.
Retry has transient/permanent classification and terminal budget; quarantine has owner retention alert and safe redrive.
Recovery calculations use continuing ingress sustainable effects and per-partition/downstream ceilings.
Replay pins range/code/config/schema isolates output gates effects bounds rate and reconciles before promotion.
Reviewer observes changed-constraint reasoning delayed recall safety and exact cleanup.
